clue.text: Old soldier's to be taken in to get settled

indicators.note: the soldier is to be taken in, held inside the word for old

parts.note: old means aged
RE, the Royal Engineers, stands for soldiers; the 's is 'is', joining it to what follows

explanation.surface: A veteran is about to be admitted somewhere so that matters can be settled.
explanation.definitionFit: Settled, as in a deal both sides have accepted, is a synonym of having come to terms.

clue.text: Survey in a paper is distorted

indicators.note: distorted means twisted out of shape, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A newspaper's survey is misleading.
explanation.definitionFit: To survey something is to assess or evaluate it, a synonym.

clue.text: Elected to be sent back

definitions.meaning: voted in, as a candidate in an election

explanation.surface: Someone chosen in a vote is promptly sent home.
explanation.definitionFit: A successful candidate is declared this, and goods sent back are this too.

clue.text: School bill's rising

indicators.note: in a down entry, rising means reading upwards, so backwards

parts.note: a note is a banknote, a bill; the 's is 'is'

explanation.surface: School fees keep going up.
explanation.walkthrough: Eton is a famous English private school.
explanation.definitionFit: Eton College is a well-known English boarding school, an example of the definition.

clue.text: The kind of capital in a buoyant economy?

definitions.text: The kind of capital in a buoyant economy?

parts.words: The kind of capital in a buoyant economy
parts.note: buoyant suggests something that stays on the surface of water

explanation.surface: An economics question about what sort of money a thriving economy holds.
explanation.walkthrough: Buoyant economy reads as boom times, but a buoyant thing literally stays on top of water.
explanation.definitionFit: Floating capital is the working, circulating funds of a business, and buoyant things bob on the surface.

clue.text: Abandoned candidature, being too far behind

parts.note: left means abandoned
standing for election is a candidature

explanation.surface: A candidate gave up a run for office after slipping hopelessly behind.
explanation.definitionFit: A runner outpaced by a long way is said to be this, an idiom for trailing badly.

clue.text: A fellow artist's depicted looking up at a distance

indicators.note: in a down entry, looking up reverses the letters

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, is an artist

explanation.surface: A man in a painting gazes upwards at something far away.
explanation.definitionFit: Afar is a literary adverb meaning far off, a synonym.

clue.text: I love to eat what's in the medicine chest?

parts.note: O is zero, love in tennis
to dine is to eat

explanation.surface: Someone loves to raid the medicine cabinet for a snack.
explanation.definitionFit: Iodine tincture is an antiseptic once kept in every home first aid cupboard, an example.

clue.text: An egg's to be cooked in holy water

indicators.note: cooking an egg changes it, so the letters are reworked

parts.note: the plural eggs, the apostrophe ignored

explanation.surface: An egg is going to be boiled in sacred water.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of egg's supplies its S to the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ganges is the river sacred to Hindus, so its water is holy, an example.

clue.text: Car driver that's liable for duty

definitions.meaning: the fuel is what drives a car's engine
fuel in Britain carries a heavy excise tax, fuel duty

explanation.surface: A motorist who may be called up for service.
explanation.definitionFit: Motor fuel powers a car and is taxed with a well-known excise levy.

clue.text: Switch positions from time to time

definitions.meaning: the two settings a light switch can be in

explanation.surface: Something changes its stance every so often.
explanation.definitionFit: A switch has two settings, and the same phrase means intermittently or occasionally.

clue.text: Place with unique way to get around dump?

parts.note: one means single, unique
a horse is a means of transport
a town is a place

explanation.surface: A rubbish tip with its own special route round it.
explanation.definitionFit: A dump is a dull, dreary place, and a sleepy backwater town is called this idiomatically.

clue.text: Crooked king is in bad way

indicators.note: the king is in, placed within the rearranged word way
bad suggests the word way is spoilt and its letters reworked

parts.note: R, for Rex, is the abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A dishonest monarch has fallen into a sorry state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' rearranges WAY to AWY, and 'is in' puts R inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Crooked means askew or out of line, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Gangs that can give one a sense of anxiety

indicators.note: the words gangs that can supply, from within themselves, a run of letters

explanation.surface: Gangs can make a person feel anxious.
explanation.definitionFit: Angst is a German loan word for dread or acute worry.

clue.text: Scoffed about knight making money for gambling

indicators.note: the word for scoffed goes around the knight

parts.note: scoffed means ate greedily
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: Someone gobbled food around a knight who was earning money from betting.
explanation.definitionFit: In poker, the stake each player puts in before the deal is called this.

clue.text: Spots or moles

explanation.surface: Blemishes or birthmarks on skin.
explanation.definitionFit: To spot is to see, and moles are undercover agents working within an enemy body.

clue.text: Length a boxer will go to for a jab

definitions.text: Length a boxer will go to for a jab

parts.words: Length a boxer will go to for a jab
parts.note: a boxer's arm span decides how far a punch can land

explanation.surface: How far a fighter would go to get a vaccination.
explanation.walkthrough: Jab looks like an injection, but it is a short punch.
explanation.definitionFit: A boxer's arm span, the distance a punch can travel, is this term.

clue.text: He cuts inside the fold

parts.note: a fold is a pen for flocks, and the man clipping wool works inside it

explanation.surface: Sounds like someone trimming within a crease of paper or cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: Fold looks like a crease, but it is an enclosure for farm animals.
explanation.definitionFit: A farm worker who clips fleeces works within the sheep pen, the fold.

clue.text: Award going to Turkey's top negotiator

parts.note: a diploma is a certificate awarded

indicators.note: the top, first letter of the word Turkey

explanation.surface: A prize goes to Turkey's leading envoy.
explanation.definitionFit: A diplomat is an official who negotiates between nations, an example.

clue.text: American moved secretly

indicators.note: moved suggests the letters are shifted around

explanation.surface: An American relocated without telling anyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Hearings held privately are said to be held in a judge's chamber, Latin in camera, meaning secretly.

clue.text: Facsimile I put on record mistakenly

indicators.note: done mistakenly, so the letters come out in the wrong order

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to wrongly filing a copy.
explanation.definitionFit: A facsimile is an exact copy, which is a synonym.

clue.text: In talk one's active though one's talk is idle

definitions.text: In talk one's active though one's talk is idle

parts.words: In talk one's active though one's talk is idle
parts.note: a chatterer is busy talking, yet the talk is idle tittle-tattle

explanation.surface: A paradox: being busy in conversation while saying nothing of worth.
explanation.definitionFit: Idle talk about other people is a definition of tittle-tattle, and a chatterer is busy with it.

clue.text: American girls — they're a sight in Norfolk

definitions.meaning: the Norfolk ... are a network of lakes and rivers in eastern England

explanation.surface: American women make quite a spectacle on holiday in Norfolk.
explanation.definitionFit: US slang for women, and the name of famous waterways in the English county of Norfolk.

clue.text: A Republican gets into outsize rows

indicators.note: the A and Republican go inside the abbreviation for outsize

parts.note: OS is the clothing abbreviation for outsize

explanation.surface: A Republican joins in some enormous political quarrels.
explanation.walkthrough: Rows suggests arguments, but here it is the verb to row a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: To row is to propel a boat with blades on poles, and those blades give the verb its use.

clue.text: Intends to produce wealth

definitions.meaning: money or resources, as in a person of independent wealth

explanation.surface: Someone plans to make money.
explanation.definitionFit: Intends and wealth are both senses of the same word, one a verb and one a noun.

clue.text: Regularly applies to be seen with a petition

indicators.note: taking every other letter of applies at regular intervals

explanation.surface: Someone routinely applies, wanting to be seen with a formal request.
explanation.definitionFit: A petition is an earnest request or appeal, which is a synonym.

clue.text: Beer's served up in error

indicators.note: in a down entry, served up means the word is read upwards

parts.note: pils is a type of lager beer; the 's is 'is'

explanation.surface: A barman serves the wrong beer by mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: A slip is a small mistake, a synonym.

clue.text: Street silver speculator

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A trader in silver on the Street, as in Wall Street.
explanation.definitionFit: On the stock exchange, someone who buys new shares to sell quickly at a profit is called this.

clue.text: Stable one working horse

parts.note: a stall is a compartment in a stable
I is the Roman numeral one
on means working, switched on

explanation.surface: A single working horse kept in a stable.
explanation.definitionFit: A stallion is an uncastrated male horse, an example of the general word.

clue.text: Site my allotment to give hindrance for old golfers

indicators.note: allotment suggests dealing out, so the letters are distributed afresh

explanation.surface: A gardener complains that the site of their plot gets in the way of elderly golfers.
explanation.walkthrough: An allotment is a small rented plot for growing vegetables in Britain; here the word signals the shuffle.
explanation.definitionFit: In old golf rules, a ball blocking another's line to the hole on the green was this obstruction.

clue.text: Delay when mail has broken open

parts.note: post means mail

indicators.note: the word open is broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Delivery is held up because a package has burst open.
explanation.definitionFit: To delay is to put off until later, a synonym.

clue.text: She gives expression of surprise about label being back to front

indicators.note: the cry of surprise goes around the reversed label

parts.note: aha is an exclamation of surprise or discovery

indicators.note: the word for label is read in reverse order

parts.note: a tag is a label

explanation.surface: A woman gasps at a label that is on the wrong way round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being back to front' turns TAG into GAT.
explanation.definitionFit: She stands for a woman, and this is a woman's first name, as in Christie.
